scope_rule: Mother library serves all future design styles, not only the 18 Nature Launch designs. Nature Launch is one consumer of the library, not its boundary.
purchase_rule: Inclusion in the mother library does not authorize purchase. Low/mid/high quality guidance, offline sourcing views and exact procurement specs are generated from this database only after evidence and sourcing requirements are defined.
excel_rule: Do not generate the user-facing Excel yet. Future Excel is an export/view of the mother database, grouped by category, and must include a single-bead/single-item image field.
offline_sourcing_rule: The future offline sourcing version is a filtered export of approved/target sourcing items, not a separate master database.
next_data_work: Define low/mid/high sourcing-quality reference for each material using material-specific criteria.
Assign/curate single-bead or single-item reference images by category.
Keep trade-name/material-identity uncertainty explicit for commercially named materials.
Do not create purchase quantities until a real sourcing plan or BOM requires them.
